label: Good-general favouring: depends on betterness at fixed end content, beyond present inputs
definition: GoodGeneral good fitOf Present φ: for some variation scenario s and candidates x, y, the favouring profile φ depends on the betterness standard with the end-realization feature held fixed (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2, BecauseOfGoodness good fitOf φ s x y), and at least one of x, y is not a present input of the favouring at s. The first clause excludes a favouring that factors through its end content (a nature determined to one end, a law selecting by its own fixed functional); the second excludes a comparator that responds only to what is actually presented to it (a balance).
note: Stipulative analyst notion (#2145 Investigation 4), attribution deferred. It inherits from BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2 the need for a scenario that varies betterness while end-realization is fixed; on the control carrier the witness is cBetter against actual, not the counterpossible valueless scenario. If betterness factors through end-realization, nothing is good-general (variationCore). See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section on joint coherence.
